gloss: to look good (on camera); to be photogenic

definitions.gloss: to look good (on camera); to be photogenic
definitions.explanation: Describes something that looks attractive in photos or videos. A modern colloquial term derived from {映|は}える (はえる, to shine/stand out).

examples.japanese: この{料理|りょうり}、すごく{映|ば}えるね。
examples.english: This dish looks really good in photos.

examples.japanese: {映|ば}える{写真|しゃしん}を{撮|と}りたい。
examples.english: I want to take a photogenic picture.

examples.japanese: このカフェは{映|ば}えスポットとして{有名|ゆうめい}だ。
examples.english: This cafe is famous as a photogenic spot.

notes:
{映|ば}える (ばえる) is a modern colloquial term that became popular with social media culture, particularly Instagram. It's derived from the traditional verb {映|は}える (はえる, to shine/stand out).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {映|ば}える{写真|しゃしん} (ばえるしゃしん): photogenic photo
- {映|ば}えスポット (ばえスポット): Instagrammable spot
- インスタ{映|ば}え (いんすたばえ): Instagram-worthy

USAGE NOTE:
This reading ばえる is informal/colloquial. The standard reading {映|は}える means "to shine" or "to look attractive" in a more general sense.
